properties.name: Documentation
properties.purpose: The explanation reflow2 ships with itself. Modelled as a subsystem of the product rather than as material about the product, on the user's call (2026-07-24): documentation is part of any deliverable, and a system handed over without it has not been fully delivered — his analogy was designing a fighter jet in reflow2 and shipping no documentation to the people who must operate it. The consequence taken seriously here is that documentation gets the same treatment as code: its files are registered Artifacts with checksums, so a README that drifts away from what the system does is a detectable defect rather than a thing someone eventually notices.
